caribbean.headline: Heavy Rain for St. Lucia, Moderate Offshore Seas
caribbean.paragraph: St. Lucia is experiencing easterly swell with seas to 5.2 ft, a 7 s dominant east swell, light winds around 12 kt and a 75% rain probability at the main port of Castries. I advise port authorities and cruise operations to prepare for localized heavy downpours and brief visibility reductions, and note Turks & Caicos will see stronger offshore winds to 21 kt while seas remain moderate.

mediterranean.headline: Strong SW swell pushes small craft caution at Mykonos
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos is experiencing 24 kt southwest winds, a dominant SW swell at a 7 s period and 6.8 ft seas. I'm advising small craft operators to exercise caution, as the 24 kt winds meet Small Craft Advisory criteria; Cadiz remains relatively quiet with 13 kt winds and less than 10% rain probability.
